index.metaTitle: LALA Bridge — equipment so Lalíderes can study
index.metaDescription: LALA Bridge connects donors with verified Lalíderes from the Latin American Leadership Academy. Donate laptops, phones and other study equipment.

hero.desc: Connect with verified Lalíderes and donate the tools they need to study, work and lead. Every device you give opens a door.

how.desc: Whether you're donating equipment or receiving it, the process is simple, secure and built on trust.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.desc: Donors sign up freely. Lalíderes verify their identity with their LALA verification code.

step2.title: Connect & browse
step2.desc: Donors list equipment and Lalíderes share their needs. One side offers, the other accepts.

step3.title: Donate & transform
step3.desc: Once the match is accepted, both sides see each other's contacts to arrange the delivery.

verified.title: Verified identity
verified.desc: Every Lalíder provides their LALA verification code and registered name. Only real community members.

network.title: Built for Brazil
network.desc: The pilot starts with the LALA network in Brazil, designed for people who only go online through their phone.

matching.title: Confirmed matches
matching.desc: Donors offer help, Lalíderes request donations and whoever receives the offer decides. Nothing happens without a person confirming.

equipment.title: Any equipment
equipment.desc: Laptops, phones, headphones, books, monitors: anything that helps a Lalíder study and work better.

privacy.title: Privacy by default
privacy.desc: Public pages show only first name, state and cohort. Contact details appear only after an offer is accepted.

community.title: Community driven

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: LALA Bridge connects equipment donors with young Lalíderes. Many of them are teenagers, so we handle data with the utmost care and collect only what is necessary. This policy follows Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13,709/2018).
privacy.mvpTitle: Important: this is a demo version
privacy.mvpBody: In this version, all data is stored only in your device's browser (localStorage). Nothing is sent to a server of ours. This also means someone else using the same browser can see it. Do not enter real sensitive information until the version with a secure server.
privacy.dataLalider: Lalíderes: full name, email, LALA verification code, cohort, country, state and city, area of interest, shower song (optional) and a description of what they need.
privacy.dataDonor: Donors: name, email, company or organization (optional), country, state and city, and the equipment they list.
privacy.dataBoth: Everyone: offers, messages exchanged in offers and the date you accepted this policy. Your password is stored only as a hash, never as plain text.
privacy.purposeBody: To verify that you are a Lalíder, show requests and donations, connect both sides and, once an offer is accepted, show each side's contact so they can arrange the delivery. We do not sell or share data with third parties for advertising.
privacy.legalBody: We process data based on your consent (LGPD art. 7, I), given when you sign up. For teenagers, we follow the young person's best interest (art. 14): we ask that a legal guardian be aware and we show publicly as little as possible.
privacy.publicBody: Public pages show only the first name with the last name's initial, the state (or the country, outside Brazil), the cohort and the request text. Email, full name, city and verification code never appear publicly. Contact details are shown only to the two parties of an accepted offer.
privacy.aiBody: This version does not send any data to AI services. When AI features arrive, we will send the minimum necessary (never full name, email or phone), AI suggestions will always be reviewed by a person and this policy will be updated beforehand.
privacy.rightsBody: At any time you can: view and correct your data, download a copy (portability), withdraw consent and delete your account. In the dashboard, use "My data & privacy": "Download my data" and "Delete my account and data".
privacy.retentionBody: Until you delete your account or clear your browser data. When an account is deleted, completed deliveries remain only as aggregate numbers, without personal data.
privacy.contactBody: LALA Bridge is an open source project by the LALA community. Questions or requests about your data can be sent through the project's GitHub repository. In the pilot with real users, the responsible organization will be named here, together with a data protection officer.
